description: This source file is a shell library designed for testing credential handling in Git. It includes functions to check credential helpers, simulate credential rejection, clean up residual data, and conduct various tests on credential storage and retrieval, including handling of long headers, expiry, OAuth tokens, and authtypes.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Simulates a credential helper operation, reading input chunks, executing git credential commands, and comparing expected output.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Reads input lines until a separator ('--') is encountered, echoing each line.

methods.name: helper_test_clean
methods.description: Cleans up previous credential data for various hosts and protocols.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects a credential for a specific protocol, host, and username via git.

methods.name: helper_test
methods.description: Runs a comprehensive set of tests on a specified credential helper, verifying storage, retrieval, overwriting, forgetting, handling of long headers, timeouts, password expiry, OAuth tokens, and authtypes.

methods.name: helper_test_timeout
methods.description: Tests timeout handling in credential helpers.

methods.name: helper_test_password_expiry_utc
methods.description: Tests handling of password expiry times stored in UTC.

methods.name: helper_test_oauth_refresh_token
methods.description: Verifies storing and retrieving OAuth refresh tokens.

methods.name: helper_test_authtype
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving authtype and credential data, including handling of ephemeral credentials and matching capabilities.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a shell script to simulate an askpass program, echoing a message and returning a credential string.
